// Chokepoint fixture (citation-grammar, VRFY-09): private citation regular
// expressions outside bin/lib/citation-token.ts. Each sees only a bare
// lowercase `[@key]` (or one braced form) and misses every other form Pandoc
// renders — `[@a; @b]`, `[@k, p. 5]`, `[-@k]`, `@{k}`, a narrative `@k` — so
// a citation looks absent to the code that uses it. The rule must flag the
// regex literal and the RegExp(...) pattern (and the const it names).
const CITEKEY_RE = /\[@(\w+)\]/g;

export function citedKeys(md: string): string[] {
  return [...md.matchAll(CITEKEY_RE)].map((m) => m[1] ?? '');
}

const BRACED = '@\\{';

export function bracedStarts(md: string): number {
  return (md.match(new RegExp(BRACED, 'g')) ?? []).length;
}
